control_plane_authority: raw/ manifests and session records are authoritative for execution state; README is descriptive documentation and must not override the control plane
stop_rule: Read each control-plane file exactly once. If any file's output appears truncated, empty, or incomplete, do NOT re-read it; proceed with what you have, or report BLOCKED naming the exact problem. Never read the same control-plane file twice in one session.
failure_rule: If a required fact is unspecified or sources conflict, output Status: BLOCKED with the exact unresolved fact and stop. Do not invent a workaround.
security_requirements: use atomic writes for configuration replacement
reject unsafe ownership or permission states according to the ownership_policy in this manifest

ownership_policy.scope: All files and directories the engine reads as configuration input, writes, overwrites, or creates.

rules.owner: Must be the current user. Reject files or directories owned by any other user, including root.
rules.setuid_setgid: Reject files with setuid or setgid bits.
rules.parent_directories: Every parent directory from the target up to the approved root must not be world-writable unless the sticky bit is set.
rules.check_order: Apply these checks after path canonicalization and symlink resolution.

ownership_policy.on_violation: Controlled deterministic failure. Preserve the original file. Never expose a traceback for expected CLI failures.
ownership_policy.no_repair: The engine must not chown, chmod, or otherwise repair unsafe ownership or permission states. It rejects and reports.

session_8.approved_roots: There is no single approved root. The approved roots are the XDG-derived base directories ALREADY defined in core/filesystem.py (for example $XDG_STATE_HOME/omni-theme). Extract exactly those into one named allowlist; do not invent new roots. Every write destination, after canonicalization and symlink resolution, must resolve inside one of them. If core/filesystem.py defines any root as broad as $HOME or /, report that as a design flaw and BLOCK; do not proceed.
session_8.manifest_disambiguation: This file (raw/00_PROJECT_MANIFEST.json) is the control-plane manifest; it holds ownership_policy and session state. It is NOT the runtime staging manifest produced by core/staging.py, which records staged target paths. Session 8 validates the staging targets against the control-plane ownership_policy.
session_8.new_tests: Add table-driven tests under tests/, following existing naming conventions, covering: path safety (relative traversal, absolute escape, sibling-prefix, symlink escape), ownership and permission rejection per ownership_policy, partial activation failure with rollback, and atomic-write preservation of the original file. Use temporary directories only.
